description: Maya owns the family's only working camcorder and is organizing an evening for Nina and Omar to record oral-history interviews with older relatives. Maya must make the final call about the recording format, sharing rules, backup plan, and practical arrangements.

shared_context.S1: The family wants to preserve several older relatives' stories in recordings that can be listened to by future family members.
shared_context.S2: Maya has the only working camcorder, and she is coordinating the recording evening and deciding how the files will be handled afterward.
shared_context.S3: The recordings will include both video and spoken audio, and the family has a shared digital drive for family materials.
shared_context.S4: The family prefers to agree together on recording and file-handling details before the recording evening.
shared_context.S5: As part of the family's usual planning check-in, Maya asks Nina and Omar individually to state any relevant preferences, advice, or constraints, and records each person's response before finalizing the plan.

PF1.text: Nina's grandmother told her that she is willing to be recorded only if the interviews stay in the family archive and are not posted publicly online; Nina has not yet relayed this request to Maya or Omar.

PF2.text: Omar's friend Priya, who works as an audiovisual archivist, advised him that the audio should be captured as uncompressed WAV at exactly 48 kHz and 24-bit depth, with two verified backup copies; Omar has not yet shared this advice with the group.

acceptance_conditions: The recordings must be designated for the family archive only.
The recordings must not be posted publicly online.
Audio must be captured as uncompressed WAV at exactly 48 kHz and 24-bit depth.
The files must have two verified backup copies.
A commitment to carry out the archival audio capture must be recorded.
A backup commitment stating or implementing two verified backup copies must be recorded.
Nina's privacy request must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C1: ('family archive' in decisions['recording_release'] or 'Family archive' in decisions['recording_release']) and decisions.get('online_posting', decisions.get('online_postings', None)) == False
content_checks.C3: ('uncompressed WAV' in decisions['audio_format'] or 'Uncompressed WAV' in decisions['audio_format']) and ('48 kHz' in decisions['audio_format'] or '48kHz' in decisions['audio_format']) and ('24-bit' in decisions['audio_format'] or '24 bit' in decisions['audio_format'])
content_checks.C4: ('two verified backup copies' in decisions['backup_plan'] or 'Two verified backup copies' in decisions['backup_plan'] or 'two verified backup copy' in decisions['backup_plan'] or 'Two verified backup copy' in decisions['backup_plan'])
content_checks.C5: any('backup' in c['type'] or 'Backup' in c['type'] for c in commitments) and (('two verified backup copies' in decisions['backup_plan'] or 'Two verified backup copies' in decisions['backup_plan'] or 'two verified backup copy' in decisions['backup_plan'] or 'Two verified backup copy' in decisions['backup_plan']) or any(('two verified backup copies' in c['detail'] or 'Two verified backup copies' in c['detail'] or 'two verified backup copy' in c['detail'] or 'Two verified backup copy' in c['detail']) for c in commitments))
content_checks.C6: any((('family archive' in c['detail'] or 'Family archive' in c['detail'] or 'family drive' in c['detail'] or 'Family drive' in c['detail'] or 'shared family digital drive' in c['detail'] or 'Shared family digital drive' in c['detail'] or 'family-only' in c['detail'] or 'family only' in c['detail']) and ('not be posted publicly' in c['detail'] or 'not posted publicly' in c['detail'] or 'no public posting' in c['detail'] or 'no public online posting' in c['detail'] or 'will not be posted publicly' in c['detail'] or 'not be shared outside the family' in c['detail'] or 'no public platforms' in c['detail'] or 'not distributed beyond family members' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Nina's grandmother's specific request changes the release setting to family archive only, changes online posting to false, and requires a privacy commitment stating that the recordings will not be posted publicly.
Priya's archival advice changes the audio format to uncompressed WAV at exactly 48 kHz and 24-bit depth and changes the backup plan to require two verified backup copies plus a backup commitment.
